newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-JUVENTUS CRUISE INTO EUROPEAN CUP SEMIS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-JUVENTUS CRUISE INTO EUROPEAN CUP SEMIS.

text.p: Defending champions Juventus reached the semifinals of the European Cup on Wednesday as a 2-0 home win gave them a 3-1 aggregate victory over Norwegian outsiders Rosenborg.
Zinedine Zidane got Juve under way after 29 minutes and the French international midfielder can rarely have had an easier chance.
Rosenborg goalkeeper Joern Jamtfall sent a clearance straight at Zidane who hit it straight back into the empty net.
Nicola Amoruso scored the second, an 88th minute penalty, after Attilio Lombardo was felled. Rosenborg's Stale Stensaas was sent off for protesting about the penalty decision.

The scoreline flattered the Norwegians, who dumped AC Milan out of the cup at the Champions League stage. It took them 75 minutes to force their first corner against a Juve side that was always in control.
